title: Organic Synthesis
description: A molecule built step by step, working back from the target to what is on the shelf: every step costs yield. Unlocks the Synthesis Bench.

puzzle.goal: A route of n steps keeps a fraction y of the material at each. Starting from a moles, write the moles P of product.
puzzle.name: Linear route
puzzle.ask: Find P for a = @{a} mol, y = @{y} and n = @{n}.
puzzle.method: Each step keeps y of what reached it: multiply n times.
